text: There's a store with no exits. And at ten p.m.... the lights go out.
SCP-3008. From the outside, a normal furniture store. Inside... it never ends.
You walk in for a lamp. Forty minutes later, the entrance is gone.
Day one is almost nice. Free beds. Free food. Nobody around.
Then you see the staff. Tall. Silent. No faces.
But at ten p.m.... the lights go out.
And the staff stop ignoring you.
Survivors build walls out of shelves... and wait for morning.
Then... the lights come back on.
You survived your first night. But the aisles... have moved.
